findings.detail: The editor names the agent's picture 照片 in six keys. #1517's ui.agents.settings.general.profile_picture — the only established term for this object in the shipped zh-CN catalogue — is 头像, and its actions use 图片. Three words (头像 / 图片 / 照片) now name one object inside one feature, which is what the cross-namespace agreement rule exists to prevent.
findings.recommend: Use 头像 in the editor's user-facing keys (更改 {name} 的头像, 保存头像, 替换头像, 头像居中), or record 照片 as the settled word and align the settings label in #1517. One term, one object.

findings.detail: Five keys insert a space between Chinese text and a Latin/digit run (支持 JPEG、PNG…; 该图片大于 {size} MB; 原图 {width}×{height} 像素). The zh-CN style guide says "No space inserted between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs"; the shipped corpus agrees 1079 values to 31, and #1517's same refusal reads 请选择JPEG、PNG、WebP、GIF或AVIF文件。 with no space.
findings.recommend: Drop the spaces around Latin and digit runs, or amend the guide if spacing is now the house style.

findings.detail: editor.saving uses a single «…». The zh-CN guide says the ellipsis is …… (two marks); only four shipped zh-CN values carry a single … and two of those are Latin token abbreviations (bep_…, acc_…), so the double form is the house default.

scope: ui.agents.avatar (25 keys) — full-namespace read of zh-CN against English, the core glossary and zh-CN's style guide, on PR #1537 head 478b7889387. Whole-file hashes bound.
passed_checks: ICU placeholder parity: {name}, {size}, {width}, {height}, {value} present and unaltered in every key that carries them
no ICU plural/select arms in this namespace; {size} is a whole-megabyte digit with no inflecting noun
no manual bidi control characters (RLM/LRM/FSI/PDI/LRI/RLI) in ur; Latin format names left to the render layer's isolation
format list JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF matches AGENT_AVATAR_MIME_TYPES in src/renderer/src/shared/agent-avatar/avatar-image.ts
no key left in English except the es/fr loanword Zoom and the numeric {value}×
punctuation conventions per locale (ur ۔ ،, hi ।, zh-CN ，。、, fr ’)
limitations: Browser and rendered-frame capture are not in this auditor's tool set: no screenshot, pseudo-localization or measured-overflow evidence is claimed.

Overflow was reasoned from the call sites, not measured: the editor's buttons are w-fit and the settings row wraps (flex-wrap), the preview labels are image aria-labels, and no truncate/whitespace-nowrap is applied anywhere in the avatar surfaces.
Agent semantic read; no native-speaker review.
independence: Auditor did not translate, write or edit any catalogue, context or key file; it formed its own read of the strings before opening the translator's commit message.
